name: evoc_bench_cifar100
description: evoc_bench_cifar100 is a CIFAR-100 based vision benchmark for evaluating image classification and robustness of vision models on the 100-class small-image setting. It measures model accuracy and robustness under standard and possibly perturbed evaluation conditions. The benchmark is intended for comparing representation and classifier performance across architectures and training regimes.
reputation: Built on the well-known CIFAR-100 dataset, it is familiar and widely used in the computer vision community for benchmarking image classification models.
